# Independent catalog wire fixture

`v1.index` and `v1.root` are deterministic metadata-format vectors generated by
`scripts/check_recording_catalog_fixture.py --write-fixtures`. The window objects
are opaque synthetic identities, NOT playable recordings, retained footage,
source-provenance proofs, or a locally published archive. This intentionally
exercises the structural catalog API without pretending it verifies media.

The actual-source integration contracts separately feed the retained Baseline
bitstream through the receiver, collector, recording verifier, and local owner.

The index has two windows at [3600,7200) and [10800,14400), an explicit decode
clock, and a shared initialization identity. Its root lists the deduplicated
window roots, all four roles of every window, and the metadata object itself.
The file hashes are pinned in `recording_catalog_golden_contract.rs`.
